**A‑blues scale**

| Scale degree | Note | Interval from previous note |
|--------------|------|-----------------------------|
| 1 (root)     | **A** | — |
| b3 (minor 3rd) | **C** | +3 semitones |
| 4 (perfect 4th) | **D** | +2 semitones |
| b5 (diminished 5th / “blue” note) | **D♯** | +1 semitone |
| 5 (perfect 5th) | **E** | +1 semitone |
| b7 (minor 7th) | **G** | +3 semitones |
| 8 (octave)   | **A** | +2 semitones |

**Pattern of intervals (in semitones)**  
`3 – 2 – 1 – 1 – 3 – 2`

So the A blues scale is: **A – C – D – D♯ – E – G – A**. This is the standard 6‑note blues scale (pentatonic plus the “blue” note).
